definitions.explanation: Having a strong salt taste; containing or tasting of salt.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{塩辛|しおから}い。
examples.english: This soup is a bit salty.

examples.japanese: {塩辛|しおから}い⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べすぎないで→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't eat too many salty things.

notes:
{塩辛|しおから}い describes a strong salty taste, from ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt) + ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧ (pungent/sharp). It emphasizes the sharpness of the salt flavor.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: ⟦{塩辛|しおから}→塩辛：08228_shiokara⟧く
- Noun form: ⟦{塩辛|しおから}→塩辛：08228_shiokara⟧さ (saltiness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {塩辛|しおから}い: salty (slightly formal, standard Japanese)
- ⟦しょっぱい→しょっぱい：02493_shoppai⟧: salty (casual/colloquial, very common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: salt flavor, salty taste

Both {塩辛|しおから}い and ⟦しょっぱい→しょっぱい：02493_shoppai⟧ mean salty, but ⟦しょっぱい→しょっぱい：02493_shoppai⟧ is more commonly used in casual conversation. {塩辛|しおから}い sounds slightly more formal or literary.

TASTE VOCABULARY:
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧: sweet
- ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧: spicy, hot
- ⟦{酸|す}っぱい→酸っぱい：02346_suppai⟧: sour
- ⟦{苦|にが}い→苦い：01201_nigai⟧: bitter
- ⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧ / ⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧: delicious

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{塩辛|しおから}→塩辛：08228_shiokara⟧ (without the い) is a noun meaning salted fish guts — a traditional fermented seafood product.

forms.negative: {塩辛|しおから}くなかったら
